title: maku-factory values
description: Strict for apps, runTokens and hardening; the other keys stay free until their rollout step (v4 D13, step 1 PR4).

clusterRoles.description: Render the cluster's shared ClusterRoles (the three aggregated roles, and agent-factory-flux-reader with monitor.flux). The umbrella sets false: agent-factory-crds renders them once per cluster (step 7 R10).

factory.description: The factory App: issues, labels, statuses and merges.

existingSecret.description: A Secret with keys app_id and private_key.

agents.description: The agents App: each run's token and the publisher's.

existingSecret.description: A Secret with keys app_id and private_key, mounted at /etc/agent-factory-agents.

mode.description: factory (the default): the merger signs with the factory App, and existingSecret must stay unset. separate: the merger App in existingSecret.

existingSecret.description: The merger App's Secret (keys app_id and private_key) with mode separate; empty means agent-factory-merger.
